messages:
From: Patrick O'Neill <patrick.oneill@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement kickoff — sequencing & evaluation window

Hi Priya,

Thanks for taking this on. Our procurement team asked me to capture what they need so we can lock a firm close date. High level:

- We need a clear sequencing plan: who signs what and in what order (MSA, DPA, Order Form).
- Evaluation period: 10 business days with an agreed-off test plan and SLA checks.
- Security artifacts: current SOC 2 report, encryption-in-transit confirmation, subprocessors list for the DPA.
- PO timing: procurement prefers an executed MSA + DPA before issuing PO; order form can be routed after.

Target close window: early May (aiming for week of May 3). If Redwood can provide SOC2 evidence and the DPA template by EOD Tue 4/19, we can accelerate.

Attached is our procurement checklist (procurement_requirements_ClearView.pdf) — it includes the legal contact and the template they use for vendor onboarding.

Can you circulate a mutual action plan with milestones and owners? Also, who at Redwood should our procurement team send redlines to?

Best,
Patrick

--

Subject: Re: Procurement kickoff — sequencing & evaluation window

Patrick — thanks for the checklist and clear asks. Looping Rishi (security & legal touchpoint) and Laura (sales ops / contracting) so we can move fast.

Draft high-level sequencing / MAP (attached: MAP-ClearView-20270418.xlsx):
1) Week of 4/19: Redwood sends SOC 2 artifact + standard DPA template and subprocessor list (owner: Rishi).
2) 4/21–4/30: Evaluation window (10 business days). Redwood to provide test plan and run two joint test scenarios (owner: Priya + CVH technical lead).
3) 4/25–5/02: Contract redline period — ClearView legal returns redlines to contracts@redwood.ai; we aim to resolve major points within 3 business days.
4) 5/03–5/06: Final signature window — prefer MSA executed first, DPA executed in parallel if possible, Order Form to follow (payment terms: Net30 unless otherwise agreed).

Risks / constraints: if SOC2 artefact or subprocessor list is delayed > 72 hours, evaluation start shifts and the above close window will slip. We can introduce a conditional order form (signed but contingent on final SOC2 evidence) but need legal signoff.

Next steps / asks for you:
- Confirm procurement/legal contact we should expect redlines from.
- Confirm target final sign date (you mentioned early May; can you confirm if 5/3 is a hard target?).

I'll follow up with the DPA template and SOC2 export this afternoon.

Thanks,
Priya

Subject: Internal: DPA notes & SOC2 delivery plan

Quick internal note (do not forward externally until we sanitize):

- DPA: make sure we include a subprocessor appendix (we have a current list that needs an effective date). CVH will likely request right to audit / access to audit logs — propose we offer SOC2 report + an SLA for audit-log retention (90 days) and an expedited path for signed NDA + limited access if they need deeper proofs.
- Encryption: confirm TLS version and ciphers in the FAQ doc. I will prepare a one-page encryption-in-transit statement to attach.
- SOC2: I can export the 2026 Type II package and redact client-identifying details. Target to have that packaged and uploaded to our secure share by EOD 4/19.
- Redlines: Laura, please set up contracts@ distribution and note our preferred fallback language for order form (service start contingent on verified SOC2 evidence).

I'll also draft a short sequencing checklist for legal to speed review (I think that will reduce back-and-forth).

—Rishi

Head of Security Programs | Redwood Inference

Priya — thanks for the plan. Quoting Patrick's original note below.

A couple of asks from procurement to try to compress timeline:
- Can Redwood deliver SOC2 evidence and DPA template by EOD 4/19? That would let us start the eval on 4/20.
- If you can provide an order form that's signed by Redwood and marked "conditional on SOC2 evidence", our finance team can route a PO immediately after the MSA is signed. That would let us target May 3 for production onboarding.

Also, procurement expects explicit confirmation that backups and logs are encrypted at rest — can you include that in the security note?

If you can take the conditional order form approach, we'll ask legal to limit redlines to three priority areas (data retention, subprocessors, liability cap) to keep the window tight.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — our procurement/legal lead is Patrick O'Neill (patrick.oneill@clearviewhealth.com).

Thanks,
Sofia

Team — thanks for the rapid responses. Summary + concrete next steps below (attached: sequencing-checklist-v2.pdf).

Updated timeline (compressed per ClearView request):

- Priya to run weekly check-ins (Tue mornings) during the eval window and provide status updates in HubSpot (deal CVH-2027-042).
